label: C++ 10-day backtest, cache-fix v2 + Tiered costs + reqPositions wiring
notes: Run on top of 2f7a537 + 8cee293 (start/end cache tolerance fix + 9 regression tests) and 93b03a6 (reqPositions wiring). 15 orders placed, 12 round-trips closed (100% win rate, +$49.55 net realized PnL), 3 open at end. Major cache reuse: AWK, HPE, HPQ, ARM, LRCX, AMKR, DELL, WDC, NOK, GFS, TTE, CDNS, CEG, VST all reused from prior runs. Only CSCO (partial from Run #5 abort), TSEM (truncated by Run #3's BentoServerError 504), IBM + AMAT (new symbols held this run) downloaded fresh. Wall time ~1h 7m vs Run #3's 4h 23m thanks to cache reuse fix. Run shows the engine + cache stack working end-to-end with no waste.
